summary: Payette NF alidade and log cabin recorded 1920 half a mile west of Duck Lake; abandoned 1923; no source describes what remains today.

facts.design: Alidade and log cabin, half a mile west of Duck Lake (no tower described)
facts.status_note: Abandoned 1923; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it gone; no source describes the site now

staffing.status: no documented staffing history (Idaho Fire Lookouts)

access.note: A Forest Service trailhead on Lick Creek Road reaches Duck Lake; no source describes access to the old site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in. The Forest Service describes a trailhead on Lick Creek Road about 18 miles from McCall, with a hike to Duck Lake of just under 1.5 miles one way.

notes_for_editor: History (1920 alidade and log cabin, 1923 abandonment) is consistent across three lookout pages and the FFLA list, but thin: no tower, no staff, no photo found. Nothing describes the site today; the old site is about half a mile west of the lake. Brief location conflict unchecked: FFLA 45.06083, -115.93769 vs idaho_fl 45.05735, -115.92372. The brief's 'events' lacked a 1920 build entry; added here from the sources. No photo URL found.
